snippet.title: Video Dev Blog: Skirmish Gameplay | Ashes of the Singularity II
snippet.description:
In this dev journal, BATTLEMODE shows Skirmish gameplay against three Regular AI players, highlighting a feigned retreat tactic for breaking through well defended chokepoints in the early and mid-game.

Wishlist Ashes of the Singularity 2 on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3499790/Ashes_of_the_Singularity_II/
